description: This file defines the class DProduct, which implements the DPRODUCT function for database operations in PHPSpreadsheet. It multiplies values in a specified database column that match given criteria.

classes.name: DProduct
classes.description: Implements the DPRODUCT function to multiply values in a database column with matching criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the product of a database column filtered by criteria, returning either a float or an error string.
